Coram : Kishore C. Sant, J.
 Dated : 11.07.2024
 Pc :-
01.
Both these applications are filed for withdrawal of the amount deposited by the acquiring body-appellant in this Court.

The learned Advocate has produced on record copy of order dated 20.06.2024 passed in Civil Application No. 5572 of 2024, wherein this Court had allowed the applicant therein to withdraw entire amount deposited in this Court on furnishing usual undertaking to the satisfaction of the learned Registrar (Judicial) of this Court.
02.
The learned Advocate for the acquiring body opposed the application stating that in this case interest under section 28 of the Land Acquisition Act is also granted.

When the amount is deposited,
most of the (2) ca6697.24 part of the said amount is towards interest of seven years out of which interest for six years is @ 15% p.a.
03.

Considering the above, the applicants are permitted to withdraw 60% of the amount of Nagnath Vithoba Kale vs The State Of Maharashtra Through ... on 11 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43949000/
1 compensation as per award, out of the amount deposited in this Court, on furnishing usual undertaking that in-case the appeals are allowed, the applicants shall re-deposit the amount in this Court along with interest within 12 weeks from the date of such order.
